summary: Cartesian Growth Corp III (a SPAC) filed an 8-K to report an amendment to its business combination agreement with Factorial Inc. The BCA Amendment changes the post-closing name to Factorial Energy, Inc. upon domestication as a Delaware corporation. No new financial terms, premium, or consideration were disclosed. The transaction originally contemplated a merger with Factorial and a PIPE subscription of 7.5M shares at $10.00 from an institutional investor. The amendment addresses corporate name change and domicile shift. To watch: shareholder vote timeline and redemptions; risk-arb spread relative to trust value.
